### Change type
Task of intent I0030 (plan task T15).

### Summary
Catalog template of the three blocks and the setup offer

### Context and problem
Intent #767, folder docs/product/intents/0030-agent-evals-when-skills-change/ (spec.md accepted by the owner 2026-11-14; plan.md in the plan PR). Spec refs: S19.

### Proposed outcome
See the acceptance below and the plan row T15.

### Scope and non-goals
One reviewable PR of about 400 changed lines. Nothing outside the files named in the plan's Parallel groups. Plan changes travel in their own PR (D7), never in this one. The pass-rate threshold and the eval cap are owner-set values: this task never writes a number for them.

### Acceptance criteria
Human merge (`gabo-setup` copy). Test first: a Go test of the template text fails until the catalog has the template with the commands block, the repeated-mistakes section with the two-times rule and the review-findings rule; a setup test over a fixture project fails until: with no instruction file the owner is offered the template with the project's own check commands in the commands block; with a file that already has those sections the file is unchanged; setup never overwrites text the project has.

### Verification plan
Test first (RED before GREEN). `go -C apps/cli build ./...`, `vet`, `test ./...` and `gabo check` pass. Size M.

### Related issues, PRs, or references
Intent #767. depends_on: T11. unblocks: T17. Local ids; the tracker blocked-by links match depends_on.
